scope: Structured identity and source-link index for the company profiles published in directory.md. Summaries and reference links are inherited from the existing directory. They are not claim-level evidence and have not been independently audited.

freshness_policy.notes: Fresh means checked within 90 days; review due means 91–180 days; stale means older than 180 days. A missing checked_at is always unreviewed. Freshness describes source recency, not whether a claim is true.

profile_status_definitions.not_reviewed: The directory profile is indexed, but no structured claim-level evidence audit has been completed.
profile_status_definitions.partially_reviewed: Some products or claims have been structured and reviewed; profile coverage is incomplete.
profile_status_definitions.reviewed: The currently published structured profile has been reviewed. Individual claims retain their own evidence status.

companies.display_name: Qualcomm — Hexagon NPU & Dragonfly data-center AI

companies.summary: Black Sesame Technologies (黑芝麻智能) designs automotive-grade ADAS/AD SoCs (Huashan family). Hong Kong-listed in 2024, the company focuses on safety-certified L2+/L3 platforms; A1000-family chips are reported in mass-production vehicles, with A2000 extending toward higher-performance and cross-domain AI.
